questions.question: Dr. Karim confides to Leila: 'I doubt my skills.' This feeling is called:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, what you're feeling is called impostor syndrome. It affects 70% of new graduates. It's normal, but you must not let it paralyze you. You have the skills, trust yourself.'

questions.question: How to manage the fear of making mistakes? Leila advises:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, mistakes are part of the learning process. The important thing is to recognize your limits, keep learning, and have a network of colleagues to ask for advice.'

questions.question: Karim compares himself to his classmates. Leila tells him:
options: Set up your practice without delay
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, every journey is unique. Some set up quickly, others take time to train. The important thing is to follow your own pace, not others'.'

questions.question: How to know if you are ready to practice alone?
options: When the premises are already found
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, being ready is when you feel confident, have anticipated difficulties, and have a safety net (colleagues, mentors). Confidence builds with experience.'

questions.question: Karim fears disappointing his parents. Leila replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, your parents invested because they believe in you, not for you to be perfect. Their pride doesn't depend on your immediate success, but on your fulfillment.'

questions.question: Assistantship has as its main advantage:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, assistantship allows you to gain experience, build a patient base, and prepare your practice setup with peace of mind, without the pressure of overhead costs.'

questions.question: Setting up in a rural area offers as an advantage:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, setting up in a rural area offers less competition and lower costs. However, you must be ready to work with sometimes limited means.'

questions.question: Can you set up immediately after graduation?
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, you can set up immediately, but you must be prepared: management, patient base, administrative tasks. Many choose assistantship to learn before launching.'

questions.question: To go abroad, you mainly need:
options: To assess the procedures and adaptation
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, going abroad can be a great opportunity, but you must carefully assess administrative procedures, diploma equivalences, and cultural adaptation. Research before deciding.'

questions.question: The best career decision is the one that:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, the best decision is the one that suits you, that you have thought through, and that will allow you to grow serenely. Listen to yourself before listening to others.'

questions.question: Registration with the ONMD is mandatory:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, registration with the ONMD is mandatory before practicing. Without registration, you cannot practice as a liberal dentist. It's the first step to take.'

questions.question: As a liberal professional, you must join:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, as a liberal professional, you must join CNSS to benefit from social benefits and compulsory health insurance. It's an essential step.'

questions.question: The tax identification number is obtained from:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, the tax identification number (business license) is obtained from the General Tax Directorate. It is essential for invoicing and declaring your income.'

questions.question: The average cost of a practice in Morocco is:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, the average cost of setting up a dental practice in Morocco is between 600,000 and 1,000,000 DH, depending on equipment, furnishings, and location. You must prepare your budget well.'

questions.question: To finance your practice setup, you need to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, several solutions exist: bank loans, practice setup assistance programs (State, local authorities), or micro-loans. You must compare offers carefully.'

questions.question: A business plan allows you to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, a business plan is an essential tool to convince banks to grant you a loan and to plan your activity for the first years. It's a roadmap.'

questions.question: To retain patients, you need to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, loyalty is built on quality of care, listening, regular follow-up, and a trusting relationship. No gifts, but rigor and empathy.'

questions.question: To attract your first patients, you should prioritize:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, word of mouth and networking with colleagues are the most effective ways to attract your first patients. A satisfied patient brings another.'

questions.question: On social media, you should:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, social media is a good tool, but you must be professional: share tips, information about care, and avoid overly personal content.'

questions.question: To retain a patient, you mainly need:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, loyalty is built on quality of care, listening, regular follow-up, and a trusting relationship. No gifts, but rigor and empathy.'

questions.question: Communication with patients should be:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, clear communication with simple words is essential. The patient must understand their treatment, options, and costs. This builds trust.'

questions.question: To avoid burnout, you need to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, burnout is a real risk. Set limits, take breaks, delegate certain tasks, and don't hesitate to consult a colleague if you feel exhausted.'

questions.question: To manage the stress of the first year:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, the first year is demanding. Accept that not everything will be perfect. Learn from your mistakes and celebrate small victories. Stress decreases with experience.'

questions.question: To preserve your social life, you need to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, it is essential to maintain a balance. Making time for personal life, passions, and loved ones allows you to last over time. Don't sacrifice everything for work.'

questions.question: The key to success for the young doctor is:
questions.explanation: Dr. Leila: 'Karim, self-confidence is the key. Accept that you are not perfect, surround yourself with supportive people, and continue to learn. The road is long, but you will succeed.'
